metadata.scenario: A client calls to schedule a dental cleaning appointment for next week. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Robert Jackson. I'm calling to schedule a dental cleaning appointment for next week. Hi Robert! It’s great to hear from you. Let me check our schedule for next week. Just a moment, please. Sure, take your time. Okay, I’m looking at our calendar now. What day were you thinking for the appointment? I was hoping for Wednesday. Wednesday works! What time would you prefer? How about 10 AM? Let me see... Yes, I have an opening at 10 AM on Wednesday. Great! Can you confirm the address for the appointment? Yes, the address is still 2847 North Ridge Road, Suite 205, Wichita, KS 67205, right? That’s correct. Perfect! I’ll schedule your dental cleaning for Wednesday at 10 AM. Thank you! I appreciate it. No problem at all. Is there anything else you need while I have you on the line? Actually, could you check if my nurse can come out for a medication review? Absolutely! I can check on that for you. When would you like the nurse to come? Maybe Thursday or Friday? Let me take a look... I see availability on Friday. Would 1 PM work? Yes, that works for me. Great! I will schedule a nurse visit for medication review on Friday at 1 PM. Thank you, Margaret. You’re welcome, Robert. Is there anything else we can assist you with today? No, that’s all for now. All right! To recap, you have a dental cleaning on Wednesday at 10 AM and a nurse visit on Friday at 1 PM. That sounds perfect. Great! If you have any further questions, don’t hesitate to call us back. I will, thanks again! Thank you for choosing CareFirst, have a wonderful day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
